description: This file defines a Fragment called VisibilityMetadataFragment that demonstrates how notification visibility levels (public, private, secret) affect lockscreen display. It provides UI to select visibility levels and shows notifications accordingly.

classes.name: VisibilityMetadataFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that allows users to select notification visibility options and display corresponding notifications to demonstrate lock screen behavior.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of VisibilityMetadataFragment with retained instance.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listener for the show notification button.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates a Notification object with specified visibility level.

methods.name: getVisibilityFromSelectedRadio
methods.description: Returns the NotificationVisibility enum based on selected radio button.

methods.name: showNotificationClicked
methods.description: Handles the show notification button click, creates and displays notification with selected visibility.
